messages.body:
Hi Mel,

Thanks for letting me know, that's completely fine. The reason I'd love to get something in the diary now is that Jake's bookings are already going in right through to Christmas 2027, so the good Saturdays are going quickly.

He's had outstanding reviews everywhere he plays. It's his own voice rather than an impersonation, he's a breath of fresh air compared with other acts covering the 50s to 70s, and at clubs like yours he quickly becomes the talking point, with regulars asking when he's coming back.

As your first six months are full, I'm happy to hold one Saturday for you from June 2027 onwards at his base rate of £250 cash for 2 x 1 hour, so you can trial him with your members. Just tell me which month suits and I'll send over the free dates and lock one in before they go.

Thanks again,
Natalie
Booking agent for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
